L1-cleaning_business_forms.d:
Look professional from the first walk-through to the final invoice. 20 cleaning business forms plus 2 Excel calculators, in one clean matching style, ready to fill on screen or print.

WHY THIS PACK IS DIFFERENT
• Room-by-room checklists for every job type: standard, deep, move-in/out, office and vacation rental turnover
• Excel quote calculator: enter your rates once and every estimate totals itself (with tax)
• Income & invoice tracker that flags unpaid jobs
• Fillable PDFs AND editable Word files, in US Letter and A4, with a logo slot
• Team tools: time & job log, route planner, quality inspection and client key log

• C-01 New Client Intake & Walk-Through
• C-02 Cleaning Estimate Worksheet
• C-03 Cleaning Service Agreement (editable template)
• C-04 Residential Cleaning Checklist

• C-17 Referral Cards (8 per page)
• C-18 Gift Certificates (3 per page)
• C-19 Service Menu & Price List
• C-20 Quality Inspection Checklist

EXCEL CALCULATORS
• Cleaning quote calculator: line totals, tax and grand total
• Income & invoice tracker: totals, tips and unpaid balances highlighted

GREAT FOR
House cleaners, maid services, Airbnb / vacation rental cleaners, janitorial and commercial cleaning companies, and anyone starting a cleaning business.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the ZIP and unzip it (right-click > Extract All on Windows, double-click on Mac).
2. Open 00_START_HERE.pdf.
3. Type into the fillable PDFs in free Adobe Acrobat Reader, or edit the Word files to add your logo and change any wording.
4. Print as many copies as you need.

FILE FORMATS
• Fillable PDF (US Letter + A4)
• Editable Word .docx (US Letter + A4): Microsoft Word, Google Docs, Pages, LibreOffice
• Excel .xlsx calculators: Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
